Its other bucket is split for this report into ota = Thefork Integration + First Table and tp = everything else left in other, so ota + tp equals the view's other bucket exactly.

Metric = SUM(covers) by booking-created date (sr_created_at in Europe/London), is_deleted = false, status_simple <> Canceled, seating areas containing bar excluded. The date predicate is a plain sargable range on sr_created_at with both ends bounded, one window per query, and every query returned first time with no timeout. The eight-week trend is one contiguous range bucketed by date_trunc week.
